scope: This static matrix records the source-freeze state; the distribution manifest binds it to packaged source. Subsequent exact-source/archive receipts supply executed release, graphical OS and live-probe outcomes without rewriting the tested archive. Local and authored fixtures do not replace authenticated provider or commercial authorization gates.

criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Current official Codex 0.167.0 and 0.169.0-alpha.7 schema/profile checks; credential-free native sandbox probe; independent authority/resume tests. Authenticated construction remains pending.

criteria.requirement: Current 0.3 source end-to-end real local-model retest
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Equality-corrected source, actual HTTP onboarding and live Qwen3-1.7B via pinned llama.cpp b12242: single builder exhausted three calls with invalid input-field artifacts; actor/critic passed in three calls after rejecting malformed JSON, automatically repairing construction and obtaining a separate critique. Export x=17→34 and reuse x=41→82 passed. Aggregate FAIL; actor/critic remains a scoped PASS.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: All eight recorded dependencies matched the equality-corrected executed source throughout this run; this is not live inference from a later extracted ZIP. Prior successful, failed and withdrawn runs retain their original source identities. Actual/configured context 16384. Wall 79.86 s and child CPU 154.31 s; complete economic costs unknown. Ordinary arithmetic/reuse ties. One observed repair does not establish reliable construction across policies or other engines.

criteria.requirement: Actual single-model and multi-agent orchestration
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Actual local Qwen3-1.7B single-builder (one inference call) and builder/critic (two distinct inference calls) completed frozen arithmetic construction.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Historical 0.2 source-bound live inference evidence; current 0.3 end-to-end live retest is separate (B6). Separate roles share one local model; multi-provider combinations are contract-tested. Narrow arithmetic task, not general reasoning or invention superiority.

criteria.requirement: Construct and independently check a usable artifact
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Live local model constructed calculator.json; frozen checks passed; exported RUN_INSTRUMENT.py executed outside HARNESS and returned 34 for x=17.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Historical 0.2 source-bound live inference evidence; current 0.3 end-to-end live retest is separate (B6). Bounded arithmetic grammar. A useful executable construction, not arbitrary-code or open-world scientific validation.

criteria.requirement: Retain, reopen and reuse on a different successor
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Close/reopen integrity-protected state; inherit artifact onto distinct successor inputs; rerun frozen successor acceptance.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Finite numerical transfer only; current acceptance and authority are not inherited.

criteria.requirement: Measure successor advantage against competent ordinary reuse
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Compare retained execution against competent equal-content ordinary reuse, counting construction/verification/maintenance declarations.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Ordinary reuse ties. No successor performance or discovery advantage established; unknown economic costs remain unknown.

criteria.requirement: Independent mechanism comparison and negative result preservation
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Independent evaluator and conventional comparator; preserve initial failed checks and negative/tied result.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Bounded computational mechanism; no general invention superiority or empirical economic validation.

criteria.requirement: Credential, permission, protocol, quota and malformed-output failures
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Execute invalid credentials, consent, protocol, budget, missing usage, malformed response and interrupted stream regressions.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Transport fixtures plus actual local model; remote account-specific behavior remains live-unverified.

criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Contract and cryptographic tests; no real Pro sign-in or revocation completed.

criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Cancel stale model output; fail unauthorized tools; persist and resume after actual subprocess crash during repair; round-trip browser JSON.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: No externally executed consequential actions; uncertain upstream requests remain charged/recorded.

criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Reject foreign origin and unsafe files/imported runners; enforce local-only before dispatch; redact fragmented credentials.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Tested Linux private workspace boundary. Windows protection code remains platform-unverified.

criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Reject corrupt, traversal, symlink, substituted-source and forged-manifest archive cases.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Integrity requires an independently trusted published checksum; self-consistency is not authenticity.

criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Exact committed package and external digest

criteria.requirement: Actual bounded self-upgrade construction against HARNESS acceptance
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Isolated source subclass ran the actual HARNESS checker: baseline 7 verification calls, candidate 5, competent ordinary reuse 5; incorrect/changed/missing cases refused.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Authored bounded recipe; no automatic production promotion. Original checker/evaluator remain outside candidate edit authority. Exact archive reruns this demonstration.

criteria.requirement: Different successor task and causal reuse comparison
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: One fresh nonce after public equality-corrected source freeze 0398ea3196f57b9adb6ed77a691e24738a5f2d86: candidate and ordinary control correctly adjudicated 32/32 successor cases with 20 new checks plus 12 reuses; uncached and inheritance-withdrawn arms adjudicated 20/32 with 20 checks. Zero errors in all arms.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Distinct internal selection task with fresh generated instances, not a new external task family. All arms incur 24 initial plus 20 successor calls. Strong ordinary control ties; no complete-cost superiority. Earlier receipts retain their original interpreter hashes.

criteria.requirement: Complete-cost self-upgrade advantage
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Executed successor comparison ties competent conventional memoization; all arms incurred 24 initial plus 20 successor evaluator calls. Directly evaluating only the 32 successor cases would use 32 calls.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Complete-cost superiority is not established. Engineering, verification, transfer, maintenance and host economic costs remain unknown. A comparison can pass correctness while failing this advantage gate.

criteria.requirement: Bilingual Ω user journey, authorization and evidence export
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Nineteen DOM scenarios exercise bilingual Ω entry, permission refusal/consent, capability/vault/replay, foundry construction/qualification/hash-bound research activation/rollback, monitor consent and scheduling, conventional tie display, export, delayed connector initialization and failed-connection recovery.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: DOM route fixtures; source construction and fresh successor are independently exercised by the CLI and reviewer protocol. Actual rendered-browser status remains separately tracked under I1.

criteria.requirement: Autonomously discover and construct new bounded HARNESS upgrades beyond the built-in recipe
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: The bounded recipe and a model-driven source-editing pathway are implemented. Contract fixtures establish the latter’s authority and verification flow, not autonomous discovery or a live model-written improvement.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Broad valuable-upgrade discovery, objective achievement, external-task transfer and complete-cost advantage remain unestablished. The new interpreter-module adapter has a finite arithmetic correctness contract; live model construction is separately blocked under O11.

criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Authorized current-source retrieval, timestamped provenance, targeted reproduction and condition reevaluation
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: O12 covers the implemented monitoring contract and O13 a separate live public-source probe. Neither reported source changes nor successful retrieval establish independently reproduced capability changes or removal of a real bottleneck.

criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Voluntary customer acceptance, executed rights/agreements, actual collections and complete-cost profit
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Economic models and declared values are not customers, funds or profit

criteria.requirement: Proof-to-Market conditional arrangement planner
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Six planner tests and loopback HTTP/UI checks exercise explicit participants, outside options, complete-cost categories, contingent funding, staged commercial records and changed-scenario invalidation.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Conditional numerical planning with operator declarations; no actual customer, executed financing, money movement or commercial success is established. O8 remains separate.

criteria.requirement: Model-driven bounded source-upgrade lifecycle and independent evaluator boundary
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Fourteen foundry contract tests plus five independently prepared security tests exercise isolated source scope, frozen authority, explicit activation, source invalidation, cancellation, rollback and sandbox-only retained execution. Protocol v2 defines 64 cases: 48 affine, four malformed/error cases and 12 independent JSON-equality expectations; direct arithmetic comparison covers the 48 affine cases only.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Contract fixtures do not establish actual authenticated model construction or native execution of all 64 cases. The candidate never executes in the host evaluator; finite correctness does not prove the operator’s objective, general improvement or economic advantage. The earlier extension review and 52-case receipts retain their original source scope.

criteria.requirement: Live authenticated model-written source upgrade under the native sandbox
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Earlier local and hosted Linux/macOS native boundary probes recorded host_sandbox_operation_not_permitted before candidate/model execution. Those receipts describe their earlier source and 52-case protocol; they are not a native run of the equality-corrected 64-case evaluator. Current hosted credential-free results are supplied separately.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Working native sandbox plus eligible official Codex/ChatGPT authorization. No authenticated model-written candidate or live retained improvement has been exercised. A credential-free original-interpreter PASS, if obtained, cannot establish model construction.

criteria.requirement: Consent-bound public-source monitoring, persistence and reported-only replay
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: Twenty-two monitor tests exercise exact source permissions, paused registration, polling/start/stop/remove, restart consent, authenticated persistence, interrupted requests, late-result refusal and reported-only replay.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: Prepared transport fixtures and actual private-address refusal. A crash between replay and receipt persistence can duplicate a reported event; this does not promote evidence. Monitoring runs only while the connector runs.

criteria.requirement: Actual authorized public-source observation through the monitor
criteria.actual_test_or_required_procedure: The preserved pre-equality-repair local official-source observation returned SOURCE_URL before verified HTTP dispatch. Its receipt is historical. Each hosted source-specific run performs a separate no-retry probe and reports its own outcome in the release supplement.
criteria.remaining_dependency_or_scope: A retrieval PASS qualifies byte observation and reported-only replay, not frontier coverage, factual verification, independent capability reproduction or an unblocked opportunity.

prior_source_context.scope: Prior 0.2 source evidence; it does not qualify newly added 0.3 source.
